The '''Gibadan Academy of Life Sciences''' was [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]]'s former employer. Their data was stolen by the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null Arcs]] in order to gather enough information to stop their accelerated aging.<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
